Radio

Radio buttons allow users to select exactly one option from a set. They are ideal for mutually exclusive choices.

Basic Radio

Standard radio buttons with labels.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="radio" name="plan" id="free" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="free" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="free">Free Plan</label>
</div>
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="radio" name="plan" id="pro" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="pro">
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="pro">Pro Plan</label>
</div>
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="radio" name="plan" id="enterprise" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="enterprise">
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="enterprise">Enterprise Plan</label>
</div>

Checked & Disabled

Radio states for selection and availability.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="radio" name="state" id="checked" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="checked">Selected option</label>
</div>
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="radio" name="state" id="disabled" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" disabled>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="disabled">Disabled option</label>
</div>

Inline Radios

Display radio buttons horizontally.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-check-inline">
  <div class="zak-form-check">
    <input type="radio" name="size" id="sm" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="sm">
    <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="sm">Small</label>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-check">
    <input type="radio" name="size" id="md" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="md" checked>
    <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="md">Medium</label>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-check">
    <input type="radio" name="size" id="lg" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="lg">
    <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="lg">Large</label>
  </div>
</div>

Card Radio

Radio buttons styled as selectable cards.

HTML 
<div class="zak-card-checkbox-row">
  <label class="zak-card-checkbox">
    <input type="radio" name="payment" value="card" checked>
    <div class="zak-card zak-card-bordered">
      <div class="zak-card-body">
        <strong>Credit Card</strong>
        <span class="zak-form-text">Visa, Mastercard, AMEX</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </label>
  <label class="zak-card-checkbox">
    <input type="radio" name="payment" value="paypal">
    <div class="zak-card zak-card-bordered">
      <div class="zak-card-body">
        <strong>PayPal</strong>
        <span class="zak-form-text">Pay with your PayPal account</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </label>
</div>

Button-style Radios

Radio buttons styled as toggle buttons.

HTML 
<div class="zak-btn-group" role="radiogroup">
  <input type="radio" class="zak-btn-check" name="size" id="s" value="s">
  <label class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline" for="s">S</label>
  <input type="radio" class="zak-btn-check" name="size" id="m" value="m" checked>
  <label class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline" for="m">M</label>
  <input type="radio" class="zak-btn-check" name="size" id="l" value="l">
  <label class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline" for="l">L</label>
  <input type="radio" class="zak-btn-check" name="size" id="xl" value="xl">
  <label class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline" for="xl">XL</label>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-form-checkCheck container
.zak-form-check-inputBase input
.zak-radioRadio-specific styling
.zak-form-check-labelLabel
.zak-form-check-inlineInline layout
.zak-card-checkboxCard-style radio
.zak-btn-checkButton-style radio input

Accessibility

  • All radios in a group must share the same name attribute.
  • Each radio must have an associated <label> via for/id.
  • Use role="radiogroup" on container elements with aria-labelledby.
  • Only one radio in a group can be checked at a time.
  • Support keyboard navigation: arrow keys to move between options.
